verses.text: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

segments.text: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty;
Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith:
The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

verses.text: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.

segments.text: Thy throne is established of old:

verses.text: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.

segments.text: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah,
The floods have lifted up their voice;
The floods lift up their waves.

verses.text: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.

segments.text: Above the voices of many waters,
The mighty breakers of the sea,

verses.text: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
